items.title: Reading Highlights
description: Searchable, shuffleable feed of passages I've highlighted while reading, live on this site
Express API pulls from a self-hosted BookOrbit library, caches it, and serves seeded shuffles so paging stays stable
Old Kindle highlights migrated in with a notebook scraper and an importer that builds stub EPUBs
items.longDescription: Every passage I highlight while reading ends up in a self-hosted BookOrbit library; this feature pulls them onto binoy.co. The Express API logs in to BookOrbit server-side, pages through the annotations, caches the list, and answers word searches, per-book filters and seeded random shuffles from that cache, so 'Show more' never repeats a card. Book covers are proxied and cached too. Years of pre-BookOrbit Kindle highlights were brought along with a browser-console scraper for the Kindle notebook and a Node importer that wraps each book's highlights in a tiny EPUB and creates one annotation per passage.

items.title: This Website!
description: React portfolio with a small Express API behind it, packaged as two Docker containers
Site content (projects, experience, skills) and images are served from the API, not baked into the build
Pushing to master runs tests and a build, then a self-hosted runner redeploys the containers
items.longDescription: Portfolio application built with React 18 and react-router, served by nginx alongside an Express API in Docker Compose on my homelab. The API owns the site content and images as well as the reading highlights integration, so updating the site is a JSON edit rather than a rebuild of the frontend bundle. Deploys are automatic: a GitHub Actions workflow runs the backend tests and the production build, then a self-hosted runner on the server pulls master, rebuilds the images and waits for the health check. Features dark mode, particle effects, and a responsive layout down to small phones.

items.title: Lockstep
description: Browser-first puzzle game where all players move together each turn
Built an in-game level editor for designing and publishing custom maps
Implemented pathfinding-based level verification with leaderboard-backed challenge progression
items.longDescription: Multiplayer browser puzzle game centered on coordinated movement, with a full custom level creation pipeline and integrated level editor for rapid map iteration. Includes pathfinding-based puzzle level verification and backend-backed leaderboards to support replayable challenge progression and community-created content.

items.title: Bubbles, Together
description: Real-time collaborative drawing application with WebSocket architecture

Self-hosted with Node.js backend and p5.js frontend
items.longDescription: Real-time collaborative application enabling simultaneous multi-user interaction through WebSocket technology. Built with Node.js backend and p5.js frontend, implementing efficient particle systems and real-time state synchronization. items.title: Generative Spiral Art

items.longDescription: Interactive 3D generative art application utilizing WebGL and advanced mathematical algorithms for real-time visualization. Implements Bézier curves, Perlin noise, and dynamic parameter manipulation through keyboard and mouse controls. items.title: Ping

items.title: Tankmania

items.longDescription: Unity3D simulation featuring advanced multi-agent AI systems with configurable team dynamics and scalable entity management. items.title: Fractal Tree

items.title: Game of Life

items.title: Bubblify

items.title: Pong
